verdicts.reason: A shoves everything to the left, leaving the right third of the canvas dead white. The watercolour texture ends in a hard vertical edge at about x=595, and the barrel photo is narrower than the texture beneath it, so the two layers don't line up and the layout looks broken and lopsided. B keeps the original stack centred, so it is coherent and readable, but it is just the square design shrunk and boxed between empty white side margins with no reflow for the wide format. The texture also sticks out past the photo's left edge, and the logo, wordmark and tagline stay small in the wide canvas.
